input_template:
Attempted operation and expected result: ...
Error text or recent review verdicts: ...
Previous attempts, fixes, and outcomes: ...

questions.name: failure_kind
questions.instructions: Classify the failure using the supplied evidence. Reserve transient_capacity_or_timeout for explicit capacity, rate-limit, temporary availability, or timeout evidence. Do not assume a deterministic code failure is transient.

choices.description: Temporary service capacity or a timeout makes another attempt plausible without a code change.
Evidence shows a test intermittently fails on unchanged code.
A code or logic defect needs correction before another attempt.
Missing credentials, tools, configuration, or prerequisites prevent the operation.

questions.name: looping
questions.instructions: Does the supplied attempt or review history show the same underlying problem recurring across rounds despite retries or patches? A single failure without recurrence is not a loop.
